reviews.title: 2 price increases?!?!?!
reviews.text:
This is a great app. I love making beautiful and simple custom estimates and invoices. I’ve been able to play around with the structure and get creative with formatting because the templates can be restrictive. There’s no place to have a written terms and conditions at the end of the invoice, or a place to explain process and that sort of thing. 

My problem with this app is the price. They have raised the price without offering any new features until this most recent update June 2023. They’re not small increases, and during such a challenging financial time for most contractors, it’s unreasonable. This is why I have it one star. Price gouging is a bad business practice. If I do 20 estimates a month that’s a dollar per estimate, and most people aren’t doing 20 a month. I can do all of this on a computer for free…and with office software on phones improving rapidly, it’s hard to understand why this app is this costly. $13-15, sure. $20?! No.

I have used this application for a few months thinking this is a great software and it is. I did a back up in July 2019 and reloaded my phone due to a software glitch unrelated to this software. When it synced it didn’t retrieve any of my paid invoices. Talking to support they blamed me for deleting my own “paid invoices” !! Being in IT I hope I know what I’m doing and why would I delete my own invoices?? Anyhow I was told the work around was they could retrieve the email invoices which is good because I emailed through there software 95% of my clients. I was just informed that I only emailed one estimate. I’m starting to realize this company doesn’t have a good software programmer and who knows what they are doing with this data. Strongly discourage them and will be reporting the whole chat log and my findings to Apple. Suggest using Quickbooks or software that’s industry proven.

Update!!!! I’m still disappointed how I felt I was accused for deleting the paid invoices, cause I know I didn’t. However the great news is they were able to retrieve 90% of my invoices and since put them on google drive. It’s a good software for simplicity. But you guys really need to work on a automatic cloud backup. Today there is no accuse for lost data even if it’s users fault. All still keep using them and know to make a paper copy backup.
